## Virtual threads (JEP 444)

Lightweight, JVM-managed threads. Millions can exist because blocking I/O unmounts them from carrier OS threads.

**Use for:** I/O-bound request handling, JDBC, HTTP clients — keep imperative style.

**Watch for:** pinning inside `synchronized` on hot paths (prefer `ReentrantLock` in Java 21; much improved in Java 24+).

## CompletableFuture

Better when you need **explicit composition** of independent async stages, custom executors, or existing reactive APIs.

## Spring Boot tip

Enable with `spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true`. Prefer MVC + virtual threads over WebFlux unless you need reactive backpressure end-to-end.
